type Base<T> = T & { other: number };
type Id<T> = T;
interface Empty<T extends { value: number }> extends Base<T> {}
interface Labeled<T extends { value: number }> extends Base<T> {
  label: string;
}
interface Plain<T extends { value: number }> extends Id<T & object> {}
interface Pair<T extends object, U extends object> extends Base<T & U> {}
interface Nested<T extends { value: number }> extends Base<{ value: T }> {}
interface Concrete extends Base<{ value: number }> {
  label: string;
}
function use<T extends { value: number }>(e: Empty<T>): number {
  return e.value + e.other;
}
const concrete: Concrete = { value: 1, other: 2, label: 'x' };
console.log(concrete.value + concrete.other);
